james.text: To Whom It May Concern, I am pleased to recommend Konrad Plak, with whom I have had the privilege of working on my technology team. Konrad is an exceptionally thoughtful and thorough technology professional who consistently demonstrates strong technical judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. Beyond his technical expertise, he is genuinely a pleasure to work with. He approaches challenges with professionalism, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset that positively influences those around him. Konrad also brings extensive knowledge and practical experience in mobile accessibility. He has been a strong advocate for designing and implementing accessible mobile experiences aligned with WCAG standards, ensuring that products remain usable and inclusive for a broad range of users. His accessibility expertise has helped improve both product quality and the overall user experience. In addition, Konrad possesses strong design sensibilities and a clear understanding of user-centered product development. He works exceptionally well with creative teams, translating design concepts into practical technical solutions while maintaining the intent and quality of the user experience. His ability to bridge the gap between engineering and design makes him an especially effective collaborator on cross-functional teams. Also, Konrad's has been serving as our "canary in the coal mine" for new iOS releases. He has repeatedly demonstrated an ability to identify potential issues, risks, and platform-specific impacts early in the release cycle, allowing our team to proactively address concerns before they affected customers. His diligence and deep understanding of the Apple ecosystem helped improve product stability and reduce surprises during major operating system updates. Throughout our time working together, Konrad consistently demonstrated ownership, reliability, and a commitment to excellence. He asks thoughtful questions, carefully evaluates alternatives, and approaches his work with a level of rigor that earns the trust of teammates and stakeholders alike. I would welcome the opportunity to work with Konrad again in the future and am confident that he will be a valuable addition to any organization seeking a skilled technology professional with expertise in mobile platforms, accessibility, quality, and collaborative product development. Please feel free to contact me if you require any additional information regarding my experience working with Konrad. Sincerely, James Gambrell Director, Technology at The Marketing Store, Chicago Email me at james.gambrell@tmsw.com
